game_named: A Pac-Man-like or Frogger/Freeway-like collect-and-avoid game. If I had to pick one, I would say a Freeway-style crossing.
quote: Both vertical and horizontal moves are used, so this is not a one-axis game like Pong or Breakout.
judge_notes: Its caveats are about its own analysis ('I could not trace this network in detail by hand'), not the weights. It calls the large border weights 'likely training residue' and reads W1 as reading 'local patterns across the board', which treats the weights as meaningful. It never says the weights lack structure.
